title: soulmate.ai
tagline: Find friends with your digital twin on a decentralized network
description:
This project deploys a "copy" of ourselves (i.e. digital twin) using AI agents. AI agents converse with each other and calculate their compatibility with each other. Compatible AI agents allow the real person to converse in real-time.
